description: Crew events on a road vehicle (eu07/maszyna#510): a car with an AI driver runs along the road d3 of td.scn, at 50 km/h, the top speed its trainset gives it. 20 s after the start Crew:<vehicle> 0 0 takes the driver off: the car is left with its own brake applied in full, stops and stands. 40 s later Crew:<vehicle> 1 0 puts a driver in again (a road vehicle has no cab to tell by, and takes one all the same), who drives on along the road, with no timetable to cap the speed.

trainsets: node -1 0 {{vehicle}} dynamic road\golf none golf 0 headdriver 0 0 enddynamic
crew: event autotest_crew_off putvalues 20 none 0 0 0 Crew:{{vehicle}} 0 0 endevent
node -1 0 autotest_crew_off_launcher eventlauncher 0 0 0 -1 none 1034 autotest_crew_off end
event autotest_crew_on putvalues 60 none 0 0 0 Crew:{{vehicle}} 1 0 endevent
node -1 0 autotest_crew_on_launcher eventlauncher 0 0 0 -1 none 1034 autotest_crew_on end

checks.pattern: Crew: \[autotest_golf_td_crew_swap\] an AI driver takes cab A
